title: Data model for a Biocorner mortar production batch
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a single production batch of a Biocorner bio-based mortar, providing full traceability from the finished batch back to its product, recipe, manufacturing process, producer and secondary raw material batches.

object.description: URN of the referenced entity, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:MortarBatch:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be MortarBatch

batchCode.description: Property. Internal production batch identifier assigned by the manufacturer for traceability. Follows a structured naming convention including product code, year, and sequence number.

description.description: Property. Free-text description of the production batch including production scale, total quantity produced, and any notable quality observations.

instanceOf.description: Relationship. Relationship linking this production batch to its parent MortarProduct entity. Establishes which product line this specific batch belongs to.

producedBy.description: Relationship. Relationship to the Organization entity responsible for manufacturing this batch. Identifies the production facility and legal entity.

producedFromRecipe.description: Relationship. Relationship to the Recipe entity whose formulation was followed during production. Enables traceability from final product back to formulation specifications.

usedProcess.description: Relationship. Relationship to the Process entity describing the manufacturing procedure applied. Links the batch to specific energy, water, and waste generation data.

usedSRMBatches1.description: Relationship. Relationship to the first SRMBatch entity used as input material. Enables full upstream traceability to raw material origin and supplier.

usedSRMBatches2.description: Relationship. Relationship to the second SRMBatch entity used as input material, when the formulation requires multiple secondary raw materials.

usedSRMBatches3.description: Relationship. Relationship to the third SRMBatch entity used as input material, applicable for multi-component formulations.

usedSRMBatches4.description: Relationship. Relationship to the fourth SRMBatch entity used as input material, applicable for complex hybrid formulations.

dateCreated.description: Property. Date at which the entity was created.
